tools.name: audit_domain
tools.description: Execute a live real-time Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), JSON-LD Schema AST, and AI Agent Readiness (/llms.txt & /.well-known) diagnostic audit on any domain or URL, returning a Markdown scorecard, detected technical issues, and free copy-paste baseline fixes.

tools.name: generate_remediation_kit
tools.description: Generate ready-to-deploy AI Search & AEO remediation files (compliant /robots.txt, Cloudflare WAF skip rule, /llms.txt manifest, and linked Organization + WebSite JSON-LD @graph) for any domain, plus a direct link to unlock the deep /llms-full.txt corpus.

tools.name: create_fix_kit_checkout
tools.description: Create an instant Stripe Checkout link to unlock the 24-Hour Single-Domain Deep AI Remediation Kit ($2 one-time), Pro 5-Domain Watchdog ($5/mo), or Agency 30-Domain Suite ($15/mo).

tools.name: get_domain_benchmark
tools.description: Look up a domain AEO readiness benchmark score and 4-pillar breakdown, or query the industry leaderboard directory across SaaS, AI, FinTech, DevTools, and E-Commerce.

tools.name: validate_robots_txt
tools.description: Validate a robots.txt file or live domain robots.txt against 10 AI search crawlers (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended) and generate a 100/100 compliant configuration.
